g.text: fix: Block /.git in your web server config and never deploy the .git folder. Attackers can download your full source
fix: Remove .env from the web root and ROTATE every secret inside it.
[cors] CORS reflects any Origin with credentials
Any website can read authenticated responses from this origin.
fix: Only allow a fixed list of trusted origins.
[https] Site is served over plain HTTP
fix: Enable HTTPS and redirect HTTP to it.
fix: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=...; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/
No browser-side protection against XSS and injected scripts.
fix: Start with: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors
Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set.
[disclosure] Server header reveals version: BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.13.18
Version numbers help attackers pick known exploits.
fix: Remove the header or strip the version.
Version numbers help attackers pick known exploits.
fix: Remove the header or strip the version.
Full URLs (with tokens in query strings) may leak to other sites.
Researchers have no official way to report vulnerabilities to you.
